examples.description: Open two seconds after the opening scene for a new shot

description: Open length_ms of empty time at at_ms on every lane, so everything at or after at_ms moves later together. The main track receives a placeholder scene there (a pending scene with the prompt "Gap"; fill it with update_scene and generate_scene, or add footage). A scene or voice clip at_ms lands inside is split around the new time; text, stills, captions and stickers that span it stretch. Refuses, naming the fix: at_ms past the end of the main track, a locked track with clips at or after at_ms, at_ms within 100ms of a scene's edge, no free scene slot, the timeline or a stretched clip passing its cap, or a split passing a track's clip cap.

at_ms.description: Timeline millisecond where the new time opens, from 0 to the main track's end.

length_ms.description: How much time to insert, 100 to 600000ms (one placeholder scene).

project_id.description: The studio project (vp_…) this tool acts on.
